Name: Arborist's Catalogue
Author: ThatKingKai
Description:
[center]I'm sorry I have taken a step back from modding, I have not been intentionally ignoring everyone! I have been devoting all of my spare time to developing my own game! 

Obviously, my game has no relevance to this mod, but nevertheless I feel I should at least showcase why I have been absent for so long. 

Introducing; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458750/Wardens_of_Wen/]Wardens of Wen, available on Steam now[/url]!

Once my game has had it's full release and I have less personal pressure I plan to get back to modding once again! Thank you for your interest in my mod, and for your patience![/center]
[center][/center]
[center][url=https://discord.gg/wNkKJES6QY]Come join the Wardens Discord![/url]
[/center]

[center][color=#6aa84f][size=6][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/Jxzm68a.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6ZsaLF0.png[/img]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/DFiaCYG.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/N1k78Z9.png[/img]﻿﻿
[/b][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=3][b][font=Trebuchet MS]This catalogue, available from Robin for 20,000g will allow you to place trees from any season, or region anywhere you want!

[i]Now includes Seasonal Variants which will adjust to whichever season you are currently in! Yay, immersion![/i]

I also added in some special additions, which include;
Mystic Tree
Green Trees 1-3
Mushroom Tree 1-2
Giant Crops (Melon, Cauliflower, Pumpkin)[/font]

[/b][/size][/color][b][color=#00ffff][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/vzg5BXx.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dsck4xI.png[/img]﻿

[color=#ffff00]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]This is my first attempt at something like this, as far as I can tell there are no bugs which is not to say there are none! Please report them in the bugs section, and be sure to include any SMAPI logs as well :)
